## Summary

Describe the problem and the change.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Security hardening
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Dependency or build change
- [ ] Database migration

## Validation

- [ ] Backend tests pass (or explain why not run).
- [ ] Frontend typecheck and unit tests pass (or explain why not run).
- [ ] End-to-end tests pass where relevant.
- [ ] CI is green.
- [ ] Documentation and capability matrix are updated.
- [ ] Database and environment changes are documented.

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No credentials, private documents, customer data, or local environment files are included.
- [ ] Authorization and tenant-isolation paths have appropriate tests.
- [ ] Untrusted source content is handled safely.
- [ ] Third-party code and assets have identified licenses.

## Notes for reviewers

List trade-offs, known limitations, follow-up work, and any manual verification needed.
